data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: codegraph
edge_embedded.summary: CodeGraph 是一个为代码库构建预索引知识图谱的工具，旨在减少 Claude Code 的 token 消耗和工具调用次数。它通过分析代码中的符号及其关系，生成一个完全本地的知识图，使得 AI 助手能够更高效地理解代码结构。使用时，只需将 CodeGraph 集成到开发流程中，即可在本地快速检索代码上下文，无需将代码发送到外部服务器。这一设计特别适合大型代码库的智能导航和 AI 辅助开发，帮助开发者更快地定位关键模块和依赖关系。
edge_embedded.summary_en: CodeGraph is a tool that creates a pre-indexed knowledge graph of your codebase, reducing token usage and tool calls for Claude Code. It builds a local graph of code symbols and their relationships, enabling efficient context retrieval. Use it to speed up code understanding and AI-assisted development by providing structured code insights without sending data to external servers.

ui_devex.name: bun
ui_devex.summary: Bun 是一个一体化 JavaScript 开发工具，将运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器整合为单个高性能可执行文件，显著提升开发效率。其核心优势在于采用 Zig 语言编写并基于 JavaScriptCore 引擎，绕过了 Node.js 的 V8 开销，在保持兼容性的同时实现极速执行。开发者可用 Bun 替代现有工具链，快速构建 Web 应用、API 服务或全栈项目，体验从依赖安装到测试部署的流畅工作流。
ui_devex.summary_en: Bun is an all-in-one toolkit that accelerates JavaScript development by bundling runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager into a single fast executable. Its speed comes from being written in Zig and using JavaScriptCore, avoiding Node.js's V8 overhead while maintaining compatibility. Developers can replace their entire toolchain with Bun for faster builds, testing, and dependency management in web apps, APIs, or full-stack projects.
